title: Brown Sugar Chex Mix
creator: Morgan Geyer (MorgantheMidwestLady)
cookTime: Boil the syrup 2 minutes, then bake 30-55 minutes at 250 degrees F, stirring every 15 minutes
ingredients: 1 box (12.8 oz) Rice or Corn Chex
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 250 degrees F. Line two baking sheets with foil.
Step 2: Combine Chex, nuts, and pretzels in a large bowl.
Step 3: Melt butter, brown sugar, corn syrup, and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes.
Step 4: Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and baking soda.
Step 5: Pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat.
Step 6: Spread onto baking sheets and bake 30-55 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.
Step 7: Cool completely and break into pieces!
notes: From a Morgan Geyer (MorgantheMidwestLady) Facebook reel; the recipe is in the reel's caption. The caption calls it Chex Mix and gives no other title, so 'Brown Sugar Chex Mix' is a descriptive title. Comments and on-screen video text were not checked. Not stated: servings and prep time.
